reply_text:
I sent Pree her list in our DM. I found four Marrow Fieldworks ticket numbers:

From Moss's notes (the "Central handoffs next week" digest, 2 Jan 2026):
- #4409: a recurring timeout on the Gatehouse Check-In report at Salina North yard. Hollis flagged it before the 5 Jan handoff.
- #4412: a driver SMS prompt glitch when staging combine trailers on unpaved overflow lots.

From #central-random this week:
- #8841: Tobias, 13 Oct, about West yard Door 2 double-booking when flatbeds check in early. He posted it while answering Hollis about his dealer account, which is Marrow Fieldworks.
- PD-5302: Hollis, 14 Oct, a follow-up ticket for Marrow Fieldworks, no action needed.

Two things I didn't tell her:
- **#8841 may be a double use.** A Central weekly update from Feb 2025 gives the same number to a Tansley Parcel printer jam. It may be a reused or mistyped number, so it's worth her checking.
- **Some numbers came from places she can't see.** The brain search turned up more Marrow ticket numbers, such as #4419 and MFW-218, in emails, meetings and CRM notes. I couldn't confirm she has access to those, and they weren't in the sources she asked about, so I left them out.

What I did tell her I skipped:
- FR-882, from the same Moss digest, because it belongs to Marrow Agrisupply, not Fieldworks.
- Moss's Central cheat sheet, which has no ticket numbers.
- #central-team, #general, #help-it-ops and #inc-tansley-carrier-api, which have nothing from this week.
- Our DM, which only has her request.
